description_en: Migrates an RDS instance to a different availability zone
description_zh: 该接口用于迁移RDS实例的可用区
kebab_example: aliyun rds migrate-to-other-zone --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --region cn-hangzhou
name: MigrateToOtherZone

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the `DescribeDBInstances` operation to query instance IDs
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID. Generally, you cannot change the VPC when migrating an instance across zones.

This parameter is required if the instance is in a VPC.

However, for instances that run SQL Server, you can change the VPC
parameters.help_zh:
专有网络VPC ID。迁移可用区时VPC不能变更，需保持不变。

专有网络实例迁移可用区时必须传入该参数。
如果实例引擎为SQL Server，迁移可用区VPC可支持变更
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination zone. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query zone IDs
parameters.help_zh: 目标可用区ID，可调用DescribeRegions获取
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies when to perform the migration. Valid values:

Immediate: Performs the migration immediately. This is the default value.

MaintainTime: Performs the migration during the instance's maintenance window. For more information, see `ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime`.

ScheduleTime: Performs the migration at a specified time.

If you set this parameter to ScheduleTime, you must also specify the SwitchTime parameter
parameters.help_zh:
生效时间，取值：
Immediate：默认值，立即生效。
MaintainTime：在可运维时间段内生效，请参见ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime。
ScheduleTime：手动指定生效时间。

如果在本参数中传入ScheduleTime，则还需要传入SwitchTime参数
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The VSwitch ID.

This parameter is required for an instance that resides in a VPC. You can call the `DescribeVSwitches` operation to query existing VSwitches.

For ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL or SQL Server instances using a secondary zone for migration, you can specify multiple VSwitch IDs. Separate the IDs with commas (,) and ensure they correspond to the zones
parameters.help_zh:
交换机ID。
专有网络实例迁移可用区时必须传入该参数。可通过调用DescribeVSwitches接口查询已创建的交换机。
当RDS PostgreSQL、SQL Server实例迁移可用区配置了备可用区时，此参数可以配置多个，用英文逗号（,）分隔，与可用区对应
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:

Basic: Basic

HighAvailability: High-availability

AlwaysOn: SQL Server Cluster

cluster: MySQL Cluster

Finance: enterprise edition (triple-node)
parameters.help_zh:
实例系列，取值：

Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列
AlwaysOn：SQL Server集群系列
cluster：MySQL集群系列
Finance：三节点企业系列
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The ID of secondary zone 1.

Required for all editions except the Basic edition
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区1。
非基础系列实例需要传入该参数
parameters.name: zone_id_slave_1

parameters.help_en:
The ID of secondary zone 2.

This parameter is available only for instances of the enterprise edition (triple-node)
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区2。
仅三节点企业系列实例可传入该参数
parameters.name: zone_id_slave_2

parameters.help_en:
The scheduled time for the migration. Specify the time in UTC, using the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

This parameter is required only when you set the EffectiveTime parameter to ScheduleTime
parameters.help_zh: 切换可用区的自定义生效时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 本参数配合EffectiveTime参数使用，仅在EffectiveTime为ScheduleTime时需要传入
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to modify the instance specification during the migration.

true: modifies the specification. If you set this parameter to true, you must specify at least one of the DBInstanceClass and DBInstanceStorage parameters.

false: does not modify the specification. This is the default value.

This parameter applies only to ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances
parameters.help_zh:
是否在迁移可用区时变配。

true：变配，当配置为true时，至少需要配置DBInstanceClass或DBInstanceStorage中的一个参数。
false：默认值，不变配。

该参数仅RDS MySQL实例适用
parameters.name: is_modify_spec

parameters.help_en:
The new instance type. You can change the instance type but not the storage type. If you set IsModifySpec to true, you must specify this parameter and/or DBInstanceStorage.

For more information about instance types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276975.html
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例规格代码，只支持变更规格，不支持变更存储类型。
当IsModifySpec参数配置为true时，至少需要配置本参数和DBInstanceStorage中的一个。

实例规格代码请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276975.html
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The new storage capacity. If you set the IsModifySpec parameter to true, you must specify at least one of this parameter and the DBInstanceClass parameter.

Unit: GB.
The available storage capacity varies based on the instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276975.html
parameters.help_zh:
目标存储空间大小。当IsModifySpec参数配置为true时，至少需要配置本参数和DBInstanceClass中的一个。

单位：GB。
取值范围：不同规格可扩容存储空间大小不同，具体请以https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276975.html为准
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Buffer Pool Extension (BPE) feature for the ESSD cloud disk. Valid values:

1: enables the BPE feature.

0: disables the BPE feature.

For more information about the BPE feature, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html
parameters.help_zh:
高性能云盘的Buffer Pool Extension（BPE）功能开关，参数：

1：开启
0：不开启

Buffer Pool Extension（BPE）功能的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html
parameters.name: io_acceleration_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:

cloud_essd: ESSD PL1 cloud disk.

cloud_essd2: ESSD PL2 cloud disk.

cloud_essd3: ESSD PL3 cloud disk.

cloud_ssd: SSD cloud disk. Not recommended, as this storage type is no longer available for purchase in some regions
parameters.help_zh:
实例存储类型，取值：
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1 云盘。
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2 云盘。
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3 云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘（不推荐，部分地域已经停止售卖）
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

OrderId.description_en: The order ID. This parameter is returned only for MySQL instances
